item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las srid pa g.yo 'khrug las khro chu'i gtar tshan
item.coloph: gnad drug don drug 'dogs drug gyi/ 'khrugs bsdeb dang bcas pa 'di/ stag la me 'bar gyis dran pa nam mkha' la gdams pa'o/ rlung 'khor gyi zhal gdams dam med la ma bstan no/ dam med la bstan na bka' skyong srung mas srog chod cig rang nyid gsang la spyod do/ u ya/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya
